path_step: Successfully deleting an existing file group.
test_scenario: Verify that a Teacher can successfully delete an existing file group from a course.
test_case_title: Verify Teacher can Delete an Existing File Group
pre_condition: A Teacher is logged into the system and has navigated to the 'Files' tab of a course that contains at least one existing file group.
expected_result: The specified file group is successfully removed from the course's file tree, and the updated file structure is displayed without the deleted group.
post_condition: The file group no longer exists within the course's file management system.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the Dashboard Page (2.1.1.2 SC-004).
Select and navigate to the Course Details Page (2.1.1.3 SC-005) for a course containing file groups.
Click on the 'Files' tab to access file management.
Locate an existing file group within the displayed File Tree.
Click the 'Delete' button (element: Edit/Delete Buttons) next to the identified file group.
Confirm the deletion when prompted by the system confirmation dialog.

uncovered_conditions: Deletion of an entire file group as described in UC-COM-08: Manage Files, rather than just a single file.
